_header: ===== cherrypick-bwb — SPX daily-laddered put broken-wing butterfly, with a 1-3-2 add-on trigger experiment (paper-only) =====
_what_this_is: Every session at entry_time, one put BWB on SPX is entered at the expected move for a net credit, ~7 DTE, held to expiry -- a NEW one every session, so ~5-7 positions ride concurrently per book at steady state. Four books trade the IDENTICAL base structure; the only variable is whether/when a reversal-triggered put credit spread add-on fires (control never; delta on a raw touch; bounce on a confirmed pullback; flip on a gamma-flip reclaim). Copy to config.json (git-ignored) or ~/.cherrypick/config/bwb.json.
_symbol_note: SPX only: cash-settled, European-style -- no assignment machinery, no dividend calendar, no physical-delivery decomposition. The cleanest settlement model in the suite.
_source_note: stream_cache_db overrides the shared stream cache path; null means the suite default. This module is a pure READ-ONLY consumer of that cache -- its target expiration is served by the streamer's `expirations` request field.
_dte_note: The target expiration is the PM-settled weekly nearest dte_target (default 7) calendar days out. When the nearest date is the AM-settled third-Friday monthly, the plan shifts to the nearest PM weekly instead, ties broken toward the LONGER date. Computed from the calendar and asserted against the cache -- never nearest-matched from the chain.
_structure_note: body_offset is always 'expected_move' in v1 (the config key is declared for the advisor's benefit, not because an alternative is implemented). near_wing_increments (default 1, $5 strikes) sits ABOVE the body toward spot; far_wing_increments (default 2, config-lint-guarded >= 2) sits BELOW the body -- narrowing it to 1 collapses the broken-wing shape into a standard fly and is refused at config-lint, not at runtime.
_credit_note: credit_floor and addon_credit_floor are DECLARED ZEROS -- a deliberate departure from the suite's min_credit_pct_of_width convention (curve/ratios carry floors; this module's floor is zero by design, per the 2026-08-22 decision). Any positive credit qualifies; a non-positive credit is a recorded refusal (no_credit / addon_not_credit), never a silent skip.
_trigger_note: delta_trigger (default 0.50) is the near wing's |delta| bar. bounce_pullback (default 0.05) is subtracted from delta_trigger to derive the bounce book's confirmation bar (0.45 at defaults) -- there is deliberately NO separate bounce_peak key, so the delta/bounce arms differ by exactly one condition by construction; bounce_pullback == 0 makes bounce degenerate to delta exactly, which is why config-lint guards it > 0. flip_buffer (default 1.001, the curve contango_max precedent) is the reclaim-above-gamma_flip multiple; a value <= 1.0 would let a knife-edge tick-through count as a reclaim and is refused at config-lint.
_books_note: All four books enter the IDENTICAL BWB from the same plan on the same tick -- four-way exact pairing on the base position. `control` never arms the add-on. `delta`/`bounce`/`flip` arm on their own trigger.py condition; once armed, every tick re-prices the add-on (a non-credit tick is a recorded refusal, addon_not_credit, and the arm stays live) until the first credit tick fires it -- ONE add-on maximum per position, armed until expiry with no cutoff. Until an arm's add-on actually fires, its positions are byte-identical to control's -- an expected find_identical_readings collision, not a defect. Each arm's effective sample is its FIRE COUNT, not its trade count; every read surface carries per-arm fire counts beside any P&L from day one.
_stream_note: SPX is the only `symbols` entry. `expirations` carries the current target expiration plus every expiration still held open (the daily ladder holds up to ~7 distinct dates at steady state). `window_hints` is load-bearing: the body sits a full expected move below spot, at or beyond a default ATM window's edge, and must also cover the add-on bracket two increments below the far wing.
_tastytrade_costs_note: Overrides for the shared cost model (cherrypick.core.fees.DEFAULT_COSTS). Empty means the suite defaults. SPX carries the per-leg broad-based index exchange fee; every distinct ITM settlement pays the $5 cash-settlement event fee (no share-side pass-throughs -- SPX is cash settled).
advice_header: ===== the advised book (paper only, off by default) =====
_advice_note: This module is deliberately UNBOUNDED: every `defaults` key is advisable, the trigger thresholds included. Bounds below are VALIDITY-ONLY ranges (delta-like params in [0,1], increments >= 1, DTE >= 1, times inside RTH) -- not experiment opinion -- so 'unbounded' is implemented as 'every key is declared, with the widest range that still type-checks'. The four base books' own thresholds stay fixed and config-lint-guarded regardless of what this block allows; an advised overlay runs as its own `advised:<base>` book beside them and never touches the base books' config.
_calibration_note: A credit structure at the expected move is the canonical wins-often-loses-big shape base sample/win_rate/days gates cannot see. min_net_pnl requires the lifetime net across the qualifying sample to clear this floor before a book/arm is called qualified. The daily ladder closes ~5 positions/week/book, so the min-14-days/min-sample-20 promotion gate is satisfiable in ~4 weeks -- NOT a structurally slow advisor target, unlike curve. The correlation caveat (concurrent ladder rows share regime context; the honest unit is fire EPISODES, not fired positions) is a reading discipline, not a sample-size problem, and every read surface must say so.
live_header: ===== live gate (placeholder — see the module CLAUDE.md's Live-trading prerequisites) =====
_live_note: This module has NO live loop, no order-placement code, and no live account designation. `enabled` exists only so the suite's config/console surfaces can read a real gate for this module instead of reporting an absent one as 'unknown' — flipping it to true does nothing until a live loop is built. Guarded the same as every other live gate: hand-edit only, never through the settings surface.
